    Push-downs from pieces of the cover as finite-dimensional modules #

    For a finite convex piece S of the universal cover of a finite ray category P, a finite-dimensional representation X of D_S respecting the relations of the cover pushes down to a module over k(P) on its total space (pdMod). Morphisms of representations push down to module maps (pdHom).
